findings.finding: The outcome fork has no arrowhead toward Contain/repair; only the other subpath receives the terminal marker.

lymphNodeInterpretation: Separate lymph and blood lumens, afferent-to-sinus entry, arterial/capillary/HEV/venous route, blood-to-tissue cell crossing and separate downstream lymph egress are visible. Qualitative whole-view agreement is not an every-pixel/object identity or complete vascular atlas certification.
inflammationInterpretation: Local tissue signals, leukocyte crossing and fluid/protein entry are distinct from angiogenesis and from outcome. Schematic arrows have no measured kinetics or guaranteed benefit.
